description: Scrape any public web page as markdown, HTML, links, a screenshot or JSON. $1 per 1,000 pages, however they are reached. checkPromptInjection adds $2.50 per 1,000 pages when the scan runs, json with a schema or a prompt, summary, highlights, question, product, menu and changeTracking in json mode add $3 per 1,000 pages each when they return something. CSS rules and attributes add nothing. A PDF adds $0.50 per 1,000 pages of text from its text layer and $2.50 per 1,000 pages of text read from its picture that come back, so a PDF read with maxChars, offset or query is charged for the share of its pages that it returns, at least 1 page. Browser actions add nothing. An answer from a stored copy within maxAge costs $1 per 1,000 pages like any page. A page that comes back with a 404 or 410 status, or cannot be read, costs nothing. creditsUsed shows what the call cost. To pull fields from any page, send formats [{"type":"json","schema":{...}}] or [{"type":"json","prompt":"..."}]; a schema or a prompt needs an API key. To get a site's own data as JSON, send the site's page URL with formats [{"type":"json","parser":"<name>"}], where the parser is named for the site and the thing, as in amazon-product, and put extra inputs such as page or filters in options. Some sites can only be read this way. Parsers by site: google: maps, maps-place, maps-reviews, trends, patents, ads, flights, hotels, play-app, play-search, play-reviews; upwork: search, job; craigslist: search, listing; careers: jobs, job; indeed: search, job; realtor: search, property; zillow: search, property; expedia: hotels; booking: search, hotel, reviews; airbnb: search, listing, reviews; youtube: search, video, transcript, comments, channel, post, playlist; reddit: search, post, subreddit, user, subreddits; instagram: post, profile, comments, transcript, feed; x: profile, community, post; threads: profile, post; pinterest: search, pin, board, profile; facebook: page, group, post, comments, marketplace; tiktok: video, comments, transcript, profile, hashtag, sound, search, ads, shop, followers, following, trending, live; linkedin: jobs, job, company, profile, posts, ads; meta: ads; amazon: product, reviews, search, bestsellers; ebay: search, item; appstore: app, reviews, search, top; trustpilot: company, reviews, search; yelp: business, reviews, search; tripadvisor: search, place, reviews; glassdoor: company, reviews, salaries; crunchbase: company; g2: reviews; luma: events, event; emails; phone: numbers; bsky: profile, post; link: in-bio; twitch: profile, clips.
